newsitem.title: UK: UK "most impressive" Eurobond borrower in '96 - poll.
newsitem.headline: UK "most impressive" Eurobond borrower in '96 - poll.

text.p: Britain was voted the most impressive borrower in the Eurobond market in 1996, said investment bankers polled by financial weekly Euroweek.
The poll asked capital market practitioners at leading investment banks around the world to vote for the bond issues, banks and borrowers that most impressed them in 1996.

Britain's $2.0 billion fixed-rate bond launched in July was voted the year's best deal. It was the first leg of a refinancing of a maturing $4.0 billion FRN, and was followed by a $2.0 billion FRN which was voted fifth-best overall.
Russia's debut $1.0 billion Eurobond launched in November was voted second-best, and Mexico's $6.0 billion FRN was voted in third place.
Spain's 6.0 billion French franc 10-year bond was named the worst Eurobond of the year.
